construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in this isolated build directory

step.title: nonempty string
step.prerequisites: unique known step IDs forming a DAG

shared_schema.validation: Single shared validation layer for direct API and CLI; unknown properties and duplicate JSON keys rejected. Field choices use strict type validation before membership checks.

cross_stage_handoffs: One integrated stage: validated step graph and answer schema feed ordered completion processing, then deterministic progress and available-step guidance.
For subsequent requests, copy output.state.completed to input.initial_completed and supply new actions with the same steps.
behavior: All fixture records are clearly labeled synthetic.
Prerequisites must be completed before an action can complete a step.
Reject duplicate completion, unknown steps, cyclic graphs and invalid answers.
Output preserves input step order; actions execute in input order.
Progress includes completion count, total, percentage, finished flag, locked steps and available next steps.
Requests are atomic and do not mutate input or write runtime state.
Successful CLI invocation prints one JSON object and exits 0; validation and file errors print one error JSON object and exit 2.

test_outcomes.cli_result: One JSON object; 2 of 3 steps completed (66.67 percent), review available.
